designs.name: Watch Halo
designs.description: rays of light around it, as long as your voice is loud

designs.name: Watch Vortex
designs.description: the points swirl out into arms that reach with the voice

designs.name: Watch Nebula
designs.description: a cloud that breathes outward with the voice

designs.name: Watch Rings
designs.description: a geodesic structure of rigid rings, each turning with its own part of the voice

designs.name: Watch Liquid
designs.description: its surface ripples in waves with the voice

designs.name: Watch Galaxy
designs.description: a spiral galaxy that turns and spreads its arms with the voice

designs.name: Watch Lotus
designs.description: a bud that listens, opens to think, branches out to work, blooms to speak

designs.name: Watch Crystal
designs.description: a crystal that grows to think, gathers orbits to work, spreads wings to speak

designs.name: Watch Eclipse
designs.description: a golden eclipse: a corona to listen, orbits to think, a shutter to work, bars to speak

designs.name: Watch Synapse
designs.description: a network of nodes: tangled to think, orbiting to work, a starburst to speak

designs.name: Watch Drop
designs.description: a drop of light: a vortex to think, fibres to work, a horn of particles to speak

designs.name: Watch Wave
designs.description: ribbons of light, each a harmonic of the voice; they wind into a swirl to work

designs.name: Watch Well
designs.description: space bending into a well: ripples carry the voice, two masses circle it as it works

designs.name: Watch Black hole
designs.description: a ring of light round a shadow: gas falls in to listen, a disk to think, jets to work

designs.name: Watch Accretion
designs.description: a young star's disk of dust: it gathers into clumps to think and merges into planets to work

designs.name: Watch Face
designs.description: a friendly face whose lips follow its voice; it cups its ear to listen

designs.name: Watch Imprint
designs.description: a face seen only where it touches a pane of glass; it presses in as it speaks

designs.name: Watch Contour
designs.description: a face raised in lines of light: its lips speak, the words leave them as waves along the lines

designs.name: Watch Membrane
designs.description: a face pressing through a fabric of light: it presses closer with the voice and speaks through it

designs.name: Watch Aurora
designs.description: the northern lights over a lake: they rise with the voice and gather into a corona to think

designs.name: Watch Murmuration
designs.description: a flock of starlings at dusk: it swells to listen, spins to think, streams to work, draws the voice

designs.name: Watch Eye
designs.description: one friendly eye: its iris glows with its voice, it opens wide to listen

designs.name: Watch Lens
designs.description: a glowing red camera eye; its core flares as it speaks

designs.name: Watch Dome
designs.description: a dome-headed droid: it turns to face you, chatters with its lights, spins to think

designs.name: Watch Valet
designs.description: a fussy gilded valet, stiff and proper: it frets as it thinks and talks with its hands

designs.name: Watch Retro
designs.description: a gentle giant of the fifties, slow and deliberate: the works in its dome whirr as it thinks, neon tubes flicker as it talks

designs.name: Watch Deco
designs.description: a serene art-deco machine woman, regal and unhurried, rings of light passing around her

designs.name: Watch Rover
designs.description: a shy, curious little rover on tracks: its eyes lean in to listen, tilt when puzzled, bob when it talks

designs.name: Watch Hover
designs.description: a round floating robot, polite and brave: its red eyes glow with its voice, it drifts closer to listen

designs.name: Watch Spark
designs.description: a curious robot on tracks with shutter eyes: it leans in for input and its eyes flick while it thinks

designs.name: Watch Cruiser
designs.description: a sleek black car: its red scanner sweeps while it thinks, its dash lights up with its voice

designs.name: Watch Android
designs.description: a pale gold android with amber eyes: a tilt of the head while it thinks, a precise blink

designs.name: Watch Sentinel
designs.description: a chrome sentinel helmet whose red eye sweeps side to side, faster as it thinks; it speaks in a low glow

designs.name: Watch Ocean
designs.description: a sea at dusk whose swell rises with its voice; while it thinks the waves fall into order
